name: colab_t4
_note: UNCALIBRATED PRIOR for a Google Colab T4 runtime (the free tier's GPU), built from public specifications and assumptions, not measurements. Colab hands out different hosts; the calibration notebook micro-profiles the one it gets (memory bandwidth, PCIe, GPU roofline) before the plan runs, and the fit adjusts the rest. This machine is a third calibration target for testing the tooling and the simulator's model of a discrete GPU; it says nothing about the i9-11900KF or the M2.

devices.name: host
devices._comment: Colab VM: 2 vCPUs of a shared Intel Xeon (about 2.2 GHz), about 12.7 GB RAM. Assumed 12 GB/s usable memory bandwidth and 40 GMAC/s for llama.cpp's quantised kernels on two vCPUs.

devices.name: gpu
devices._comment: NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Turing, 16 GB GDDR6, 320 GB/s peak, about 15 GiB usable). Assumed 220 GB/s sustained and 10 TMAC/s for quantised matrix products; 70 W board power.
